scope: Local source execution with synthetic Auth, SQL, storage and navigation; no production account writes or real-login claim.

checks.name: normal-create-and-password-login
checks.detail: Actual dispatcher, creation/binding helpers and mini session; isolated Auth/SQL. New initial password enters the same store; wrong password rejected.

checks.name: recovered-password-feedback
checks.detail: Server preserves existing Auth password and returns passwordInitialized=false; mini page redirects without explaining that the supplied initial password was not applied.

checks.name: committed-store-empty-return
checks.detail: Injected committed store write with empty returned rows: creation reports DATABASE_ERROR before account creation, without write-after-read confirmation.

checks.name: committed-binding-empty-return-stores
checks.detail: Injected successful binding with empty returned rows: reports STORE_BINDING_FAILED although binding was committed.

checks.name: committed-binding-empty-return-assignments
checks.detail: Injected successful binding with empty returned rows: reports STORE_BINDING_FAILED although binding was committed.

checks.name: success-navigation-failure
checks.detail: A failed redirect leaves no success lock or recovery callback; the same page allows a second creation request. This check does not claim duplicate persisted accounts.

checks.name: success-storage-cleanup-failure
checks.detail: A local pending-key cleanup error converts a confirmed server success into a visible creation error.

checks.name: unconfirmed-result-feedback
checks.detail: Transport uncertainty does not lock the store creation form or tell the operator to first check the directory; retry issues a second request. No production timeout or duplicate account was claimed.

checks.name: account-warning-hidden
checks.detail: An account audit warning returned by the service is discarded on navigation.

checks.name: contact-failure-unfinished-store
checks.detail: Isolated contact-write failure after a committed store leaves an unfinished profile outside account-stage cleanup; later recovery is still possible.
